threshold_notes.nonpositive_penalty_too_weak_rule: true if abs(mean_true_E_non_positive) <= 0.5 * mean_true_E_positive on primary Test A/B at cost=0.03
threshold_notes.pre_cue_predictability_low_rule: true if best sign_correct_rate < 0.75 or best pearson_corr <= 0.10 on primary Test A/B at cost=0.03
threshold_notes.cf_cov1_destroyed_signal_rule: true if cf_cov1.00 best policy is >0.05 worse than primary best policy or best sign_correct drops by >0.20
